label: Abu Musa Island approaches
note: IRGC mined approaches 1987–88 (Operation Nimble Archer area). Shallow shelf <30m. Active IRGC naval base island.

label: TSS Bottleneck — Sir Bu Nu'Ayr
note: Deepest vessel concentration point. Historically flagged in USN/NAVCENT Notices to Mariners as mine susceptibility zone.

label: Greater Tunb Island — W approach
note: Iran-occupied. Shallow reef shelf. Approach vectors to inbound TSS pass within 12nm. IRGC patrol vessel base.

label: Qeshm North Channel
note: Narrow channel north of Qeshm. Depths 15–40m. Occasionally used by vessels avoiding main TSS.

label: Outbound TSS — eastern exit
note: Eastern exit of outbound lane. Depths > 60m, less mine-suitable. Monitor for dark vessel clustering.

label: Khasab Bay approaches
note: Oman. High small-boat traffic; AIS coverage poor. Not a mine threat zone but confounds dark vessel detection.
